pages.title: Grand Pet Connect
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description:
Grand Pet Connect asks you to clear a layered board of animal tiles by collecting matching triples. Tap an available tile to put it in the tray, then collect two more of the same kind to remove the set. Taking tiles away reveals others underneath.

Keep the tray from filling before another match is possible, or the level is lost. Boosters can undo moves, shuffle tiles, and provide help as the boards become more difficult.

pages.title: Office Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: Sanoma
pages.description:
Office Spider Solitaire challenges you to clear the table by building complete sequences from king down to ace in a single suit. Choose a difficulty using one, two, or four suits.

Drag a card onto one with a value one rank higher, even if the suits differ. A consecutive run can move together when all its cards share a suit, and any card can occupy an empty space. The opening layout has ten stacks, each with its top card face up.

pages.title: Pixel Shoot
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Pixel Shoot is an arcade puzzle about sending cannons onto a conveyor belt. Tap a cannon to put it on the belt, choosing the order with attention to its color. Manage capacity and the timing of your selections as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Night Club Security
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Night Club Security puts you in charge of screening visitors at a nightclub. Check people for prohibited items and decide whether they should be admitted. The simulator gives you freedom in how you deal with visitors and control entry to the club.

pages.title: Coffee Color Blocks
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Coffee Color Blocks challenges you to fill shapes by moving them to gates of the same color. Tap and slide a colored block across the board; reaching its matching gate fills the cups inside it. Complete every segment of the figure to finish the level.

Choose the movement order carefully, since one shape can block another. New levels introduce different shapes, colors, and arrangements to solve.

pages.title: Impostor among us: Escape from prison
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description:
Impostor among us: Escape from prison follows an impostor trying to break out of a space prison. Avoid traps, solve puzzles, and approach enemies to eliminate them. Defeating every enemy removes the red lasers and opens the route onward.

The game includes more than one hundred levels and boss battles. Move with WASD or the arrow keys on a computer, or use the virtual buttons on a phone or tablet.

pages.title: Spider Bubu
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description:
Spider Bubu follows a swinging character through a city filled with Halloween collectibles and hazards. Gather the candies and all three pumpkins while avoiding sharp spikes and spinning blades, then reach the portal safely.

Click and release the mouse to move between walls on a computer. On a mobile device, tap and release to control the wall-to-wall movement.

pages.title: Brainrot Click to Hatch
pages.creator: Xpresate Studio
pages.description: Brainrot Click to Hatch is a clicker about releasing and collecting unusual Brainrots. Keep tapping to accumulate energy, unlock upgrades, and advance their evolution into stranger forms. Work toward completing the collection, including MAX POWER versions. Use the left mouse button for the main activity and the interface.

pages.title: Alchemy Puzzle
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Alchemy Puzzle asks you to combine simple materials into new objects to solve its levels. Choose items and look for a combination that produces a new discovery. One recipe shown by the game combines land and an apple seed to create an apple tree.

pages.title: Yummy Tales 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Yummy Tales 3 takes you to a farm with Oscar the dog, where matching produce helps feed the animals. Make groups of at least three identical fruits or vegetables to clear them and meet the current level goal before your moves run out.

The game has more than 2,500 levels, with boosters that remove blockers and help with difficult boards. Daily gifts, missions, and challenges offer additional rewards and boosters.

pages.title: Roller Coaster Rush
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Roller Coaster Rush puts you in control of a coaster traveling through jumps and steep drops. Adjust its speed to get through the track without crashing. Hold the left mouse button or Space to accelerate, then release to slow down. Each level tests the timing of those changes as you handle the track ahead.

pages.title: Gangsta Duel
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Gangsta Duel puts you into street battles against a large wave of enemies. Use combat skills to attack the gangsters and defeat them all. Play with mouse clicks or taps as you work through the fighting.

pages.title: Mathematics Racing
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Mathematics Racing turns correct answers into speed on the racetrack. Solve arithmetic examples to accelerate your car; mistakes slow it down. Five correct answers in succession activate turbo acceleration. The difficulty adjusts automatically according to how often you answer correctly.

Spend your winnings on cars with different acceleration and maximum speed characteristics. Further levels make more cars available, giving you additional options as you race and solve the examples.

pages.title: Frogtastic Marble Adventure
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Frogtastic Marble Adventure challenges you to stop an invasion of colored spheres. Shoot into matching colors to create groups of three or more, making those spheres explode. Stop them all before they reach the end of their route. The moving spheres follow an increasingly winding path, so choose your shots while keeping up with their progress.

pages.title: Gravity Matcher
pages.creator: Neru Games
pages.description: Gravity Matcher asks you to launch circles into a changing gravity field and match identical ones. Circles come in different sizes and types, and gravity can pull a poorly aimed throw away from its intended path. Drag to aim, then release the mouse button to shoot, timing each launch carefully.

pages.title: Ninja dash Cozy tactic puzzle
pages.creator: RDV Indie Games
pages.description:
Ninja dash Cozy tactic puzzle challenges you to clear enemies from each location with only a limited number of attacks. Plan a route that uses walls and other objects to bounce your ninja onto a new trajectory.

Control the character with the mouse and rotate the camera with A and D. On a mobile device, use the on-screen buttons.

pages.title: Wordmeister HD
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Wordmeister HD is a word-building game in which English vocabulary earns points. Drag letter tiles into place to make words, using the English dictionary as the basis for valid entries. Double-letter and triple-word bonus spaces can increase the value of a play. Build your total and aim to finish with the highest score.

pages.title: Get Ready With Me: Concert Day
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Get Ready With Me: Concert Day follows Riri as she puts together a look for a concert. Start by customizing her cowgirl hat, then choose makeup, an outfit, and accessories to complete her preparations. Use the mouse to make your choices through the styling stages.

pages.title: Girl Coloring Dress Up Games
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description:
Girl Coloring Dress Up Games combines doll styling with making your own coloring pages. Choose hairstyles, outfits, and accessories, then color clothes and backgrounds with gradients, textures, patterns, and glitter. You can move and change the dolls and scenery to compose the picture.

Zoom in or out to work on the details. Use the left mouse button to change an outfit as you build a coordinated design.

pages.title: Pin Detective
pages.creator: Gamee JSC
pages.description:
Pin Detective sends you into a mansion to investigate a wealthy woman's disappearance. Pull pins to gather clues and explore the mystery surrounding its strange animals and biological laboratory. A wrong choice can put the detective in danger and cost a life.

You can also use coins to renovate the mansion and buy clothes while working through the pin puzzles.

pages.title: Brainstorming 2D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Brainstorming 2D is a sliding puzzle about clearing every block inside a grid's colored borders. The squares share their colors with the surrounding edges, and the number of colors varies between puzzles. Slide to move the blocks as you work to clear the board.

pages.title: Garden Tales Mahjong 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Garden Tales Mahjong 2 combines garden-themed tiles with solitaire mahjong puzzles. Match tiles to clear boards across at least 250 layouts. Quick Play offers puzzles for an immediate game, while Chapters Mode lets you unlock more puzzles as you complete them.

When you get stuck, tools called Shuffle, Torch, and Hint can help you continue through the chapters.

pages.title: TicToc Fall Fashion
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: TicToc Fall Fashion lets you update the looks of three friends for autumn. Choose bold makeup colors, combine sequined clothing with knitwear, and finish the outfits with purses and jewelry. Put together a separate look for each friend as you explore the available clothes and accessories. Use the mouse to select the items.

pages.title: Iconic Celebrity Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Iconic Celebrity Look is a dress-up game about helping princesses recreate the styles of their favorite celebrities. Choose outfits for the princesses and put together celebrity-inspired looks from the available wardrobe. Click the left mouse button to make your selections.

pages.title: Parents Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Parents Run turns raising a baby into a running course with upgrade doors. Tap the screen to guide the baby through the doors, choosing those marked with a plus sign to improve the character as you progress.

pages.title: Space Escape
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Space Escape is a movement puzzle about guiding an astronaut back to a spaceship. Use the keyboard's left, right, up, and down controls to move the astronaut into position and reach the ship to escape.

pages.title: Pop Balloon
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Pop Balloon is a ricochet puzzle about clearing balloons with a spiked ball. Set the launch angle and strength, then send the ball into the play area. It rebounds from the walls, letting you reach balloons along the bounce path. Burst every balloon to win. Press and hold the screen, then swipe back to adjust launch power.

pages.title: Wizard School
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Wizard School lets you build and manage a school for children born with magical abilities. Develop a place where young wizards can learn to use their wands and control their powers. Choose how to allocate your money among different approaches to student training as you grow the school.

pages.title: Steve Ball Temple
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description:
Steve Ball Temple follows Steve through a temple filled with monsters and collectible stars. Keep him alive and reach the end of each level, gathering stars along the way. Each stage has three stars to collect, though one is enough to pass.

Use WASD or the mobile touch controls to move. Double-jump through the temple and get on top of monsters to defeat them.

pages.title: Pony Friendship
pages.creator: winxland.ru
pages.description:
Pony Friendship is a logic puzzle about reuniting two lost ponies in a forest. Move one pony and the other mirrors its actions from the opposite side. Bring them together at the center using as few moves as possible.

Play with touch controls, the mouse, WASD, or the arrow buttons.

pages.title: Valentine's Day Hidden Hearts
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find ten hearts in each scene of Valentine's Day Hidden Hearts. Click on every heart you spot before the timer runs out, working through six levels of hidden-object searches.

pages.title: Bridge Builder
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Bridge Builder follows Boxie on a hurried journey through danger. Build bridges along the way to help him get through, using the mouse or touchscreen to play.

pages.title: Fast Furious Skyline
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Fast Furious Skyline puts a Skyline car into two survival challenges. Use the arrow keys to move and Space to jump, getting past obstacles while trying to stay in the game. Earn scores and ranks, then collect hats for your car.

pages.title: Emoji Game
pages.creator: Newness Games
pages.description: Emoji Game puts your emoji choices against hidden columns. Pick four favorites and confirm them, then see whether they match what the columns reveal. Aim for correct matches in at least two columns. When lives run low, the game offers a rewarded-video option to restore them.

pages.title: Square
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Keep the ball inside its enclosure in Square. The bottom edge is open, so tap as the ball reaches that area to close the gap. Repeat the action whenever it returns to the bottom, keeping it from escaping the square.

pages.title: Christmas Mahjong Connection 2020
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Christmas Mahjong Connection 2020 challenges you to remove matching pairs of Christmas tiles and empty the board. A pair can connect only when its path has no more than two right-angle turns. Use the mouse to select pairs and work through the levels.

pages.title: Donutosaur
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Help a hungry monster reach sweets in Donutosaur. Change his shape and reverse the direction of gravity to collect candies and get him to his favorite food, a doughnut. His friends can push, pull and destroy objects to help you solve the puzzles.

pages.title: Eggs Brick Breaker
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fire eggs to rescue your chicken friends in Eggs Brick Breaker. Keep from hitting the chicken coop while working toward the rescue, and use upgrades to strengthen your chicken. Play with the mouse.

pages.title: Pregnant Anna And Baby Care
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help Anna prepare for motherhood in Pregnant Anna And Baby Care. Begin by buying baby products, then help her prepare for the birth as Kristoff calls an ambulance. The newborn needs your care too. Use mouse clicks or taps to play through the activities.

pages.title: Pixel Arena Game FPS
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description:
Pixel Arena Game FPS puts you against enemy soldiers and pixel zombies in a shooting game with multiplayer and offline play. Play with friends or work through forty offline levels. Modes include gun game, survival, team deathmatch and deathmatch.

Move with WASD, use the mouse to shoot, aim, look around and change weapons, and press Space to jump. Shift makes you run, while Tab opens the menu.

pages.title: Defence Of Corona Virus Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Defence Of Corona Virus Hidden challenges you to locate ten stars concealed in each picture. Click or tap a star when you spot it, and find the full set before the countdown reaches zero.

pages.title: Italian Cars Differences
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Compare car pictures and find their changed details in Italian Cars Differences. Each of the ten levels contains seven differences to locate within one minute. Click or tap the details you find to mark them before time runs out.

pages.title: Jumpy Tile
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Jumpy Tile asks you to guide a tile past obstacles and other tiles. Move around the objects in its path, using the arrow keys or tapping the screen to control the tile.

pages.title: Viking Dragon
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Viking Dragon follows a warrior setting out alone to prove his fighting ability. Move through the action with the arrow keys and shoot with Space; touch controls are also available.

pages.title: Pixel World
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description:
Pixel World gives you a kingdom to explore, build and reshape. Move with WASD, select blocks with the number keys from 1 to 8, left-click to hit blocks and right-click to create them.

Experiment with the tools and items as you modify the world. Press F for flying mode and use Q and E to move up or down. Other options include a torch on L and summoning a deer with Y.

pages.title: Toy Car Simulator : Car Simulation Game
pages.creator: MAS PRODUCTION
pages.description: Toy Car Simulator : Car Simulation Game puts you behind the wheel of a toy car. Drive forward, reverse and steer with the keyboard while trying its three modes and different levels.

pages.title: ATV Quad Bike Simulator 2020 Bike Racing Games
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Ride a four-wheeled quad along mountain tracks in ATV Quad Bike Simulator 2020 Bike Racing Games. Handle sharp turns and dangerous off-road routes, drift near the mountain edges, and perform stunts. The tracks include daytime, nighttime and snowy settings, giving you different conditions to drive through.

pages.title: Parkour Race
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Run, jump and slide toward the finish in Parkour Race. Race opponents through 3D pixel environments and try to reach the line first across 20 levels. Earn gold coins by winning races and completing levels, then spend them on character skins. Hold and swipe to guide your runner through the courses.

pages.title: Crazy Taxi Jeep Drive Game
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Drive a jeep through a mountain setting in Crazy Taxi Jeep Drive Game. Travel between hills, mountain routes and tourist points as you steer through the landscape.

pages.title: Easter Eggs Match 3 Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Match groups of three or more identical eggs in Easter Eggs Match 3 Deluxe and meet the target for the current level. The puzzles become harder as you progress, and hourglasses, bombs and jolly eggs provide assistance along the way. Use the mouse to play.

pages.title: Dragon Hunt Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Assemble dragon pictures in Dragon Hunt Jigsaw. Pick one of 12 images, then choose a puzzle size: 25 pieces for Easy, 49 for Medium or 100 for Hard. Use the mouse or touch controls to put the pieces together and restore the selected picture.

pages.title: Baby Vincy Aquarim Game
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Clean and decorate a fish tank in Baby Vincy Aquarim Game. Start by moving the fish out and emptying the dirty water, then clean the tank thoroughly. Refill it with fresh water before returning the fish. Once the cleaning is done, decorate their aquarium to finish caring for their home. Use the mouse to carry out the maintenance tasks.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Easter Fun
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel prepare for an Easter rally in Baby Hazel Easter Fun. Make an Easter goody basket with colorful eggs, then get her ready to join her friends and pets for the celebration. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel during the Easter preparations.

pages.title: Sky Car Stunt 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Race along tracks high in the sky in Sky Car Stunt 3D. Drive fast and compete against rival racers while taking on the elevated courses. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move your car through the sky rally.

pages.title: Iron Ball
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Iron Ball is a physics puzzle in which you aim and shoot with the mouse. Use the shots provided to destroy all the red balls and finish the level. Blue balls also award points when destroyed, but they are not required for completion.

pages.title: Tap Tap Robot
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Tap Tap Robot puts you in control of a diamond-collecting robot. Tap the screen or use the mouse to change its direction, guiding it toward the diamonds. Gather every diamond to complete the level.

pages.title: Transportation Vehicles Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Build a high score in Transportation Vehicles Match 3 by arranging same-colored blocks into lines of at least three. Keep an eye on the meter on the left: letting it drop too low ends the game. Use mouse or touch controls to make your matches.

pages.title: Baby Sisters Christmas Day
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Use the mouse in Baby Sisters Christmas Day to help Bella and Mia prepare their Christmas party. Pick looks for the two sisters and decorate the party hall for the celebration.

pages.title: Zombie Smash
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Smash zombies with the mouse in Zombie Smash, stopping them before they can enter your space.

pages.title: Happy Hop Online 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guide the hopping characters through stages in Happy Hop Online 2. Use the left and right arrow keys to jump, tackle the obstacles in each stage, and make use of powerups along the way. The game also includes different costumes for your character.

pages.title: Super Buddy Kick Mobile PC
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Super Buddy Kick Mobile PC lets you put Buddy through a barrage of weapon attacks. Use the mouse or touch controls to hit him with hammers and blades, shoot with pistols and rifles, or try grenades and flames.

pages.title: Don't Drop
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Toss an egg from one nest to the next in Don't Drop. Tap to launch it toward the nest above, timing your throw for targets that may stay still or move in different directions. Each egg has a time limit, and collecting stars along the way adds to your score.

pages.title: Ice Hockey Shootout
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Ice Hockey Shootout challenges you to score past a goalkeeper and defenders. Swipe the puck toward the net, choosing a path that gets it through the opposition. Keep aiming for more goals and unlock unusual puck designs, including a sardine can and cheese, as you play.

pages.title: Pixie Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat a fairy’s flower allergy in Pixie Skin Doctor. Pixie arrives at the hospital with irritated skin after passing some flowers, and you help care for her. Tap to play, use a laser to clear red spots, and remove the magical hair that keeps growing on her skin.

pages.title: Just S Rush
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Just S Rush challenges you to move a ball between circular targets. Tap to send it in the direction of the arrow, timing the launch to reach the next target. Successful landings add to your score, and a countdown limits how long you can wait before launching again.

pages.title: My xylophone
pages.creator: ReCorp Games
pages.description: My xylophone lets you explore musical notes by playing a virtual instrument. Select its keys to hear their sounds and watch them light up, with animations appearing as you play.

pages.title: Defeat Your Friend
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Challenge a friend in Defeat Your Friend, a collection of six competitive mini games. Choose from Pong, Tic Tac Toe, Memory, Hi-Low, Math Wars, and Dot and Boxes. Follow the controls shown before play, using the mouse, touch or keyboard as indicated, and try to outscore or outplay your opponent.

pages.title: Galaxian
pages.creator: Intersoft Ltd
pages.description: In Galaxian, steer a ship across the screen while firing at an enemy fleet. Move with the mouse or left and right arrow keys, and shoot by clicking or pressing Space. Dodge enemy ships and their shots to protect your shield. Destroy the entire fleet to clear the level and unlock the next one.

pages.title: Stairs Game
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Guide a ball up an endless staircase in Stairs Game. Hold the left mouse button and drag left or right to control its position, avoiding spikes as it climbs. Collect rubies along the way and aim for perfect combos as you keep moving upward.

pages.title: Air War 1941
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Air War 1941 puts you in a fighter plane in a scrolling aerial battle. Move through the level and shoot down enemy aircraft while collecting coins to improve your score.

pages.title: Archery Apple Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Archery Apple Shooter asks you to shoot the apple balanced on a man's head without hitting him. Move the mouse to aim, hold the left button to draw the bow, and release to fire.

Successful shots increase the distance to your next target, so adjust your aim and shot power as you work toward a new best distance. Keep an eye on your limited supply of arrows.

pages.title: TIKI TIKI HOP
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: TIKI TIKI HOP challenges you to jump from column to column and build a high score. Hold Space or the mouse button to charge a jump, then release to leap. Landing in the center of a column earns a bonus, so judge each jump's power before letting go.

pages.title: Flying Triangle
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Flying Triangle sends you through a scrolling course of horizontal barriers. Tap or hold the left or right side to steer the triangle through the gaps and keep it from crashing. A collision ends the run, and the scrolling speed increases at higher scores, making the gaps harder to reach safely.

pages.title: Peg Solitaire
pages.creator: Vianim
pages.description: Peg Solitaire asks you to leave just one peg on the board. Select a peg, then click an empty space to jump over another peg and remove the one you crossed. Plan your jumps around the pegs that remain as you work toward the final single piece.

pages.title: Pet Jump
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Pet Jump is a jumping game where reaching the next fruit keeps the run going. Make more jumps to increase your score, and avoid missing the fruit or the game ends. Earn enough coins to unlock different pets and use them for another run.

pages.title: Mr Paul
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Mr Paul is a platform game about collecting stars to open a portal to the next level. Move left and right and jump to reach the stars, then make your way to the portal once it opens. Pick up coins along the way to unlock additional characters.

pages.title: Boys Fashion Outfits
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Boys Fashion Outfits puts you alongside fashion advisers helping Flynn find a new outfit. Look through the clothing choices and put together a look for him, working on the outfit that brought him to the stylists.

pages.title: Pocket Anime Maker
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Pocket Anime Maker lets you create a pocket-sized anime doll by customizing its features. Choose the skin color, eyes, and mouth, then add details such as freckles or scars. A beard is also available for a male character. Use mouse or touch input to work through the options and put together your doll's face.

pages.title: Bonnie Lice Control
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Bonnie Lice Control is a hair-care game focused on removing lice and their eggs. Help the character try a special shampoo as you work on cleaning her blonde hair. The goal is to clear the infestation through the game's hair-treatment activities.

pages.title: Ultimate Swish Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Ultimate Swish Game is a basketball shooting challenge with a one-minute time limit. Click the screen or press the spacebar to stop the ball indicators and set up your shot. Choose the direction of the ball and try to score as many points as you can before the minute ends.

pages.title: Catching the Diamond
pages.creator: wuqubGames
pages.description: Catching the Diamond is a choice-based arcade game where you must send the character toward a diamond and avoid a spinning saw. Pick A or B to choose a direction. Collecting a diamond raises your total and brings another choice; choosing the saw ends the run.

pages.title: Zyppy Pixie
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Zyppy Pixie is a fruit-matching puzzle with fifty-five levels of increasing difficulty. Tap the screen to launch fruit, bringing at least three identical fruits together to clear them. Work to empty the field before the fruit reaches the bottom line.

pages.title: RoBBiE
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: RoBBiE follows a robot searching for lost chips inside a factory where the other robots have turned evil. Help him solve puzzles and get past the factory's dangers, including water, electricity, lava, and hostile robots. Use mouse or touch input to interact with RoBBiE and his surroundings as he works to restore peace to the factory.

pages.title: Vampire Queens Academy Style
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description: Vampire Queens Academy Style is a dress-up game featuring Marceline, the Vampire Queen. Browse her wardrobe and combine clothing and accessories into an outfit. Change the different parts of her look as you prepare her for an adventure.

pages.title: Classic Bowling Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Classic Bowling Game challenges you to knock down as many pins as possible with each throw. Use the arrow controls to choose the ball's direction and speed, then send it down the lane. Work on your throws and try to score strikes.

pages.title: Princess Diner de Blanc
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Diner de Blanc helps Tiana, Jasmine, Elsa, and Cinderella dress for an elegant picnic with an all-white dress code. Choose dresses, tops, heels, and jewelry for each princess, putting together outfits that suit the event. Keep the white-clothing requirement in mind as you work through their wardrobes.

pages.title: Klaverjassen
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Klaverjassen is a four-player Dutch trick-taking card game. Play cards from your hand to win tricks and score points against the players on either side of you. Keep track of the trump suit: certain cards gain more points when their suit is trump, changing which cards are most valuable.

pages.title: Golf of Cards
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description:
Golf of Cards is a solitaire game about clearing columns of cards onto an active pile. Choose an available card that ranks one step above or below the pile's top card; kings and aces can connect as well.

Draw from the deck to change the active card when you need another option. Keep removing cards to clear the board, and use the mouse to select the cards you want to play.
